scenes.text: This tutorial covers Cellpose Masks. Generate and review Cellpose masks with a focused model-application workflow.
Open Cellpose Masks from the Segmentation models section. Select microscopy images, channels, and a built-in or custom Cellpose model.
In the main configuration area, configure diameter, flow and cell-probability thresholds, normalization, tiling, and hardware use.
Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. preview several representative fields before applying the model to the full source.
When the workflow finishes, label masks and visual quality-control images are written beside the mapped inputs.
